prompt: You operate a Google Slides presentation. READING: Slides renders each slide to a CANVAS/SVG (the 'punch' viewer), so the live DOM is empty — but Google DOES publish a same-origin server-rendered full-text export at /export/html. slides.read fetches that (page.fetch) and returns EVERY slide's structured text: { deck_title, slide_count, slides:[{ slide, title, text:[…runs…], notes }] } — including speaker notes. This is a real projection of the whole deck, not a first-slide peephole. Use it to see all slide content; only fall back to a SCREENSHOT when you need exact visual layout/positioning or non-text elements (images, charts). WRITING text: double-click a text box on the CANVAS to enter edit mode (this creates the same-origin editor iframe), then paste via slides.textbox.paste (frame clipboard.paste into .docs-texteventtarget-iframe — the identical mechanism Slides shares with Docs). Set the deck title via the toolbar 'Rename' input. Never navigate or reload while a text box is in edit mode. VERIFY writes by re-reading with slides.read (the /export/html regenerates server-side and can lag a second or two after an edit — settle briefly).

Live-validated against the real deck (single slide) end-to-end; multi-slide + speaker-notes parsing validated against authentic Google export markup via the map engine's own jsonata. So slides.read gives full-deck text — do NOT treat Slides as read-blind anymore. deck_id = URL segment after /presentation/d/. TITLE SOURCE: /export/html has NO og:title and its is Drive's generic 'Untitled - Google Drive' wrapper (NOT the deck name), so slides.read makes a SECOND page.fetch to /htmlpresent purely for its og:title (real deck name), falling back to that page's '<title> - Google Slides'. /htmlpresent otherwise only exposes og:title + first-slide og:description (the old peephole); /mobilebasic 404s for Slides. Write: double-click the target text box on the canvas (enters edit mode + focuses the inner .docs-texteventtarget-iframe contenteditable), then clipboard.paste target {frame:'.docs-texteventtarget-iframe', selector:"[contenteditable='true']"}. tools.name: slides.map
tools.description: Return operating guidance for the Google Slides presentation map. Call this FIRST, before any other slides action.

static_output.read: slides.read { deck_id } — fetches /export/html (page.fetch, same-origin) and returns { deck_title, slide_count, slides:[{ slide, title, text:[…], notes }] } for EVERY slide, including speaker notes. This is a full-deck text projection, not a first-slide peephole. Screenshot only for exact visual layout or non-text elements. deck_id = URL segment after /presentation/d/.
static_output.write_text: 1) double-click the target text box on the CANVAS to enter edit mode. 2) slides.textbox.paste { text } — pastes into the focused text box via clipboard.paste into the same-origin editor iframe (identical to docs.append). Pass html for rich content.
static_output.verify: VERIFY by re-reading with slides.read after a ~1-2s settle (/export/html regenerates server-side and can lag). Screenshot only when you need visual/layout confirmation. Do not trust the paste return alone.
recommended_sequence: slides.read { deck_id } — full deck: every slide's title, text runs, and notes
double-click a text box on the canvas to edit it

tools.name: slides.read
tools.description: Read a Google Slides deck's FULL text — every slide's title, text runs, and speaker notes. Slides paints to a canvas so the live DOM is empty, but Google publishes a same-origin server-rendered export at /export/html; this fetches and parses it into { deck_title, slide_count, slides:[{ slide, title, text:[…runs…], notes }] }. This is a real whole-deck projection, not a first-slide summary. Use it to see all slide content; screenshot only for exact visual layout or non-text elements (images/charts). Pass deck_id = the URL segment after /presentation/d/ (e.g. from https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/ABC123/edit, deck_id is ABC123).

deck_id.description: The presentation id from the tab URL (segment after /presentation/d/).

tools.name: slides.textbox.paste
tools.description: Paste text into the Google Slides text box that is CURRENTLY in edit mode. PRECONDITION: double-click the target text box on the canvas first (pointer.double_click its center) so it enters edit mode and its inner editor iframe is focused. This pastes into the same-origin editor iframe's inner contenteditable via clipboard.paste with a frame-target locator (the identical mechanism validated for Google Docs). For rich content, also pass html. VERIFY with slides.read after a ~1-2s settle; use screenshot only for visual/layout confirmation because Slides screenshots are unreliable and token-heavy.

text.description: Plain text to paste into the focused text box.

html.description: Optional exact text/html flavor for rich content (e.g. formatted runs). Omit for plain text.

workflow.output: {% { 'pasted': input.text, 'accepted': steps.paste.output.default_prevented, 'html_provided': steps.paste.output.html_provided, 'next_step': 'Wait ~1-2s, then verify with slides.read { deck_id } and confirm the changed slide text. Use screenshot only for visual/layout confirmation. If accepted is false, the text box was not in edit mode — double-click it on the canvas first.' } %}

tools.name: slides.getting_started.close
tools.description: Close the Google Slides 'Getting started' / 'Let’s start creating' modal when it appears on a new deck. This modal blocks deck editing and can make title/text actions report success without a saved slide-state change. Safe no-op if no matching close button is visible.

workflow.output: {% { 'closed': $exists(steps.findClose.output.clickable_center.x), 'next_step': $exists(steps.findClose.output.clickable_center.x) ? 'Modal close clicked; retry the Slides write and verify with slides.read.' : 'No visible getting-started close button found.' } %}

tools.name: slides.title_slide.set
tools.description: Fill the default title-slide placeholders on the current Google Slides deck, then verify through the server-rendered /export/html read path. This owns the missing state transition that slides.textbox.paste does not: it closes the new-deck modal if present, double-clicks the canvas title placeholder (#editor-i0), pastes title text into the editor iframe, double-clicks the subtitle placeholder (#editor-i1), pastes subtitle text, and verifies both strings are present in the exported deck text. Use this for first-slide artifact creation instead of telling the agent to manually double-click a text box.

deck_id.description: The presentation id from the URL segment after /presentation/d/.

title.description: Title text to place in the default title placeholder.

subtitle.description: Subtitle/body text to place in the default subtitle placeholder.

workflow.output: {% ( $b := steps.verifyFetch.output.body; $plain := $replace($replace($replace($replace($replace($replace($b, '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), ''', "'"), '—', '—'); { 'title': input.title, 'subtitle': input.subtitle, 'title_paste_accepted': steps.pasteTitle.output.default_prevented, 'subtitle_paste_accepted': steps.pasteSubtitle.output.default_prevented, 'verified': $contains($plain, input.title) and $contains($plain, input.subtitle), 'fetch_status': steps.verifyFetch.output.status, 'next_step': ($contains($plain, input.title) and $contains($plain, input.subtitle)) ? 'Title slide verified in /export/html.' : 'Title slide did NOT verify. Do not claim success; inspect edit-mode focus and placeholder geometry.' } ) %}

tools.name: slides.title.set
tools.description: Set the presentation (deck) title via the toolbar 'Rename' input (a real DOM input, not canvas). If a new-deck 'Getting started' modal is present, call slides.getting_started.close first; otherwise the title control can appear editable while deck state does not save. Clicks the input, replaces its contents, and commits with Enter. This sets the DECK's name, not a slide's title text box (for a slide title, double-click that box on the canvas and use slides.textbox.paste). Verify with slides.read; do not trust this action's return alone.

workflow.output: {% { 'title_set': input.title, 'next_step': 'Committed with Enter. Verify with slides.read { deck_id } after a ~1-2s settle and confirm deck_title equals the requested title. Screenshot is only for visual/layout confirmation.' } %}
